title: Focus Pulse
oneLiner: A 60-second focus pulse with a gentle streak — a utility app, not a game.
targetAudience: Adults who want a one-tap 60s reset without a game loop or social feed.

pillars.coreLoop: Tap start → 60s pulse → log completion → optional share
pillars.social: Optional share of today’s count — no accounts
pillars.monetization: None in v1; optional remove-ads later via Play Billing
pillars.discovery: Calm clock-mark icon; feature graphic shows a single 60 on a dark field
